description.value:
You point at a creature within range that carries a commlink and murmur a message only it can hear; that creature (and no one else) receives your words and may whisper an encrypted reply that only you hear, safe from interception or decryption by ordinary means.

You can cast this power through solid barriers if you know the target is on the other side and are familiar with it; 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood blocks the effect, though it otherwise travels freely around corners and through gaps.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
